meta.name: swing-clarify
meta.description: Prevents premature execution on ambiguous requests. Analyzes request clarity using 5W1H decomposition, surfaces hidden assumptions, and generates structured clarifying questions before work begins. Use at the start of any non-trivial task, or when a request could be interpreted multiple ways. Triggers on "뭘 원하는건지", "요구사항 정리", "clarify", "what exactly", "scope", "requirements", "정확히 뭘", "before we start".

copy.tagline: 在开始工作前自动澄清模糊需求，避免误解和返工。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常接到模糊不清的任务，需要先理清需求再动手。
